title: Locker Rental: price lock and fee increase notice terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the number of months the tier's fee is locked against increases, and the notice required before a fee increase takes effect.

## Price lock and notice table
| Tier | Price lock period | Fee increase notice |
|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | 0 months (no lock) | 30 calendar days |
| Medium Locker | 0 months (no lock) | 30 calendar days |
| Large Locker | 0 months (no lock) | 30 calendar days |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | 12 months | 45 calendar days |
| Day-Use Locker | 0 months (no lock) | 0 calendar days |
| VIP Locker Suite | 24 months | 45 calendar days |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Which tier fixes the longest price lock period? The VIP Locker Suite, at twenty-four months.
- How much notice is required before a fee increase on a Premium Climate-Controlled Locker rental? Forty-five calendar days.
- Does the Small Locker tier fix any price lock period? No; its price lock period is fixed at zero months.
